title: Total quotient rings under a Noetherian ind-etale base change
statement:
Let $A,B$ be reduced commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], where reduced means that every nilpotent element is zero. Let $f:A\to B$ be ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. For any commutative ring $R$ put $T_R=\{s\in R:sr=0\Longrightarrow r=0\text{ for all }r\in R\}$ and $Q(R)=T_R^{-1}R$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Then $f(T_A)\subseteq T_B$ and the canonical $B$-algebra map
$$Q(A)\otimes_A B\longrightarrow Q(B),\qquad (a/s)\otimes b\longmapsto f(a)b/f(s)$$
is an isomorphism. The tensor algebra has multiplication $(x\otimes b)(x'\otimes b')=xx'\otimes bb'$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. The zero ring and maps to the zero ring are allowed.

source.place: Tag 0EN6, lemma-meromorphic-quasi-coherent, proof of (1)-(2), displayed total-fraction base-change map, extended here from etale to ind-etale reduced Noetherian rings. Agent-formulated extension using Algebra Tags 00U3 (lemma-etale-over-field), 05UT (lemma-colimit-flat), 00EW (lemma-reduced-ring-sub-product-fields), and 02LX (lemma-total-ring-fractions-no-embedded-points).

proof.text: Put $S=T_A$. By [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability], $A\to B$ is weakly etale, hence flat by [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. For $s\in S$, multiplication $A\xrightarrow{s}A$ is injective. The defining injectivity property [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] makes its tensor with $B$ injective. The identifications $A\otimes_A B\simeq B$, given by $a\otimes b\mapsto f(a)b$ with inverse $b\mapsto1\otimes b$, follow directly from the tensor relations [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Under them the tensored map is multiplication by $f(s)$, so $f(s)\in T_B$.

source.place: Tag 0EN6, lemma-meromorphic-quasi-coherent, proof of (1)-(2): flat maps preserve nonzerodivisors.

proof.text: Write $C=f(S)^{-1}B$. By [lem-weil-pbc-localization-base-change] and tensor symmetry, $Q(A)\otimes_A B\simeq C$, sending $(a/s)\otimes b$ to $f(a)b/f(s)$. The tensor symmetry is induced by $b\otimes x\mapsto x\otimes b$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]; the displayed map is multiplicative by the stated tensor multiplication. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-total-fraction-fiber-decomposition] with its $R=A$ and its algebra $A=B$. It gives finitely many minimal primes $\mathfrak p_i$ of $A$, fields $k_i=\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)$, and a ring isomorphism $C\simeq\prod_i D_i$, where $D_i=k_i\otimes_A B$. Its hypotheses require only that the base $A$ be reduced and Noetherian. Empty products are permitted.

source.place: Tag 07F5, lemma-reduce-to-field, third paragraph of the proof; algebra.tex Tag 00DK, lemma-tensor-localization.

proof.text: Each $k_i\to D_i$ is ind-etale by base change [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability], hence weakly etale. For $x_i\in D_i$, the subalgebra $k_i[x_i]$ is finitely generated and therefore finite etale by [lem-weil-pbc-weak-etale-field]. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-over-field-product] it is a finite product of fields. In this product choose $y_i$ coordinatewise to be $0$ at a zero coordinate of $x_i$ and the inverse of $x_i$ otherwise. Then $x_i=x_i^2y_i$, also after mapping the subalgebra into $D_i$. This also covers $D_i=0$ by its empty product. For $x\in C$, apply this construction to its finitely many coordinates in the product of Step 2 and pull the tuple $(y_i)$ back to $y\in C$. Thus $x=x^2y$ for every $x\in C$.

source.place: Tag 092Q, lemma-absolutely-flat-over-field, moreover clause; Tag 0CKR, lemma-class-weakly-etale-over-field, (3); algebra.tex Tag 00U3, lemma-etale-over-field.

proof.text: For $t\in T_B$, its image $x=t/1$ is a nonzerodivisor of $C$. Indeed, if $(t/1)(b/f(s))=0$, the localization zero criterion [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] gives $f(u)tb=0$ for some $u\in S$. Cancelling $t$ in $B$ gives $f(u)b=0$, hence $b/f(s)=0$. Apply Step 3 to $x$: choose $y$ with $x=x^2y$. Then $x(1-xy)=0$; cancellation gives $xy=1$. Consequently every $t\in T_B$ becomes a unit in $C$. This cancellation is valid in the zero ring as well.

source.place: Section 00CM, localization fraction equality and zero criterion; coordinate calculation from the finite-field products of Tag 00U3.

proof.text: Since $f(S)\subseteq T_B$, fraction formulas define a $B$-algebra map $\theta:C\to Q(B)$ by $b/f(s)\mapsto b/f(s)$; the equality relation and the addition and multiplication formulas [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] show it is well-defined. If $\theta(b/f(s))=0$, there is $t\in T_B$ with $tb=0$, so $b=0$ and the original fraction is zero. Thus $\theta$ is injective. For $b/t\in Q(B)$, Step 4 supplies the inverse of $t/1$ in $C$; its image under $\theta$ is the inverse of $t/1$ in $Q(B)$, so $\theta((b/1)(t/1)^{-1})=b/t$. Thus $\theta$ is surjective. Compose this isomorphism with Step 2. The composite sends $(a/s)\otimes b$ to $f(a)b/f(s)$, exactly the claimed canonical map, and is multiplicative and compatible with the $B$-structure. No nontriviality assumption was used; for $B=0$ both sides are zero, and a unital map with $A=0$ forces $B=0$.

Source checks: Stacks 0EN6 (spaces-divisors.tex, lemma-meromorphic-quasi-coherent) is the étale case with the same map (a/s)⊗b↦f(a)b/f(s). For the ind-étale extension, the field-fibre facts agree with 092Q (moreover clause) and 0CKR(3) in more-algebra.tex, and with 00U3. Step 1: ind-etale-stability gives ind-étale ⇒ weakly étale, the ind-étale definition node gives weakly étale ⇒ flat, and the flat-map definition gives injectivity of multiplication by f(s), so f(T_A)⊆T_B. Step 2: localization-base-change with R'=Q(A) and D=B. Then total-fraction-fiber-decomposition is applied to the reduced Noetherian base A with algebra B, giving C≅∏κ(q_i)⊗B; the empty product is allowed. Step 3: base change makes each k_i→D_i ind-étale, hence weakly étale. By weak-etale-field, k_i[x_i] is finite étale, and by 00U3 it is a finite product of fields. A coordinatewise quasi-inverse gives x=x²y in C. Step 4 is elementary: t/1 is a nonzerodivisor in C, hence a unit. Step 5 is elementary: θ:C→Q(B) is well defined, injective and surjective, and its composite with step 2 is the stated map. Small cases checked: k[x,y]/(xy) with A_x×A_y; k⊂k^sep; Z→strict henselisation of Z_(p); a projection killing a component; zero rings. The reducedness and Noetherianity of B are unused but harmless. Duplicate candidates are lem-sfb-etale-total-fraction-base-change (étale only), lem-dl-a1-ind-etale-domain-generic-field (domains only) and lem-sc-affine-totalquotient-minimal-product; none gives the item. Accepted split_report.tool_uses (generic pbc algebra tools): ind-etale-stability, total-fraction-fiber-decomposition, weak-etale-field. No SGA cited. No changes.
